text: A stranger's odds of unlocking your Face ID: under one in a million. Your twin's?
It maps your face in 3D with thousands of invisible dots.
A neural network turns that into numbers and compares them with yours.
Apple says the odds rise for twins, look-alike siblings and kids under thirteen.
And rise again with mask mode on.
If that's your home, use a passcode, or turn mask mode off.
